name: psql
source: curated for hotdoc M2 (PostgreSQL 18 psql and common SQL; verified against official docs)

entries.title: connect to database
entries.syntax: psql dbname, psql -U user -h host dbname, psql -U user -d dbname -h localhost -p 5432
entries.description: Connect to a PostgreSQL database.

entries.title: \l list databases
entries.description: Show all databases in the server.

entries.title: \dt describe tables
entries.description: List all tables in the current database.

entries.title: \d table description
entries.description: Show columns, types, and constraints of a table.

entries.title: \df list functions
entries.description: List all functions in the database.

entries.title: SELECT query
entries.syntax: SELECT columns FROM table WHERE condition;
entries.description: Query data from one or more tables.

examples.code: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE status='active' LIMIT 10;

entries.title: INSERT data
entries.syntax: INSERT INTO table (col1, col2) VALUES (val1, val2);
entries.description: Add new rows to a table.

entries.title: UPDATE data
entries.syntax: UPDATE table SET col1=val1 WHERE condition;
entries.description: Modify existing rows in a table.

examples.code: UPDATE users SET status='inactive' WHERE last_login < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';

entries.title: DELETE data
entries.description: Remove rows from a table.

examples.code: DELETE FROM logs WHERE timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year';

entries.title: CREATE TABLE
entries.syntax: CREATE TABLE name (col type, col type, ...);
entries.description: Create a new table with columns and constraints.

entries.title: ALTER TABLE
entries.syntax: ALTER TABLE table ADD COLUMN col type; ALTER TABLE table DROP COLUMN col;
entries.description: Modify table structure.

examples.code: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN phone VARCHAR(20);

entries.title: CREATE INDEX
entries.description: Create index for faster queries.

entries.title: JOIN tables
entries.syntax: SELECT ... FROM table1 JOIN table2 ON table1.id = table2.id;
entries.description: Combine rows from multiple tables.

examples.code: SELECT u.name, o.order_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

entries.title: aggregate functions
entries.syntax: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, GROUP BY
entries.description: Calculate aggregate values across rows.

examples.code: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM users GROUP BY status;

entries.title: COPY import/export
entries.syntax: COPY table FROM 'file'; COPY table TO 'file'; \copy
entries.description: Bulk import or export data to/from files.

examples.code: \copy users FROM 'users.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true);

entries.title: transactions
entries.description: Group queries into atomic transactions.

entries.title: Connect to another database
entries.description: Switch the current psql session to another database.

entries.title: List schemas
entries.description: Show schemas in the current database.

entries.title: List indexes
entries.description: Show indexes in the current database.

entries.title: List roles
entries.description: Show database roles and attributes.

entries.title: Toggle expanded output
entries.description: Toggle expanded table output for wide rows.

entries.title: Toggle query timing
entries.description: Show elapsed execution time after each query.

entries.title: Run SQL file
entries.description: Read and execute commands from a SQL file.

entries.title: Write query output to file
entries.description: Send subsequent query output to a file until reset.

entries.title: Repeat query
entries.description: Repeat the current query buffer at an interval.

entries.title: Set psql variable
entries.description: Define a psql variable for later interpolation.

entries.title: Explain and run query
entries.description: Run a query and show its execution plan with timing and buffer stats.

examples.code: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 42;

entries.title: Create database
entries.description: Create a new PostgreSQL database.

entries.title: Create login role
entries.description: Create a database role that can log in.

examples.code: CREATE ROLE app_user WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'change-me';

entries.title: Grant privileges
entries.description: Grant database privileges to a role.

examples.code: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user;

entries.title: Vacuum and analyze table
entries.description: Reclaim storage where possible and refresh planner statistics.

entries.title: Quit psql
entries.description: Exit the psql session.

entries.title: Show current connection
entries.description: Display information about the current database connection.

entries.title: Describe table with details
entries.description: Show table columns, indexes, storage, and additional details.

entries.title: Auto expanded display
entries.description: Automatically switch to expanded display when output is too wide.

entries.title: Disable pager
entries.description: Turn off pager use for query output.

entries.title: Execute generated SQL
entries.description: Send each column of each row from the current query output as SQL to execute.

examples.code:
SELECT 'VACUUM ANALYZE ' || quote_ident(tablename) || ';' FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public';
\gexec

entries.title: Change role password
entries.description: Prompt securely for a new password for a role.

entries.title: Show last error verbosely
entries.description: Display the most recent server error at maximum verbosity.

entries.title: Set environment variable
entries.description: Set an environment variable from within psql.
